item.description:
DragStore 2.2.0

A new, calmer setup with a hands-on tutorial, and Google Drive that stays on your desktop.

New

  • Redesigned setup: smoother transitions, a progress bar and a Back button.
  • Hands-on tutorial: practise dragging files in and out, adding files from Drive and auto sort* with sample files. Nothing real is touched.
  • Auto sort looks at images* on macOS 27, so photos and screenshots are sorted more accurately.

Bug fixes and improvements

  • "Add from Google Drive" opens on your current desktop, and DragStore comes back with your new files when you're done.
  • Google sign-in no longer jumps to another desktop.
  • Thumbnails stay loaded while you scroll, without using much memory.
  • Setting up smart folders*: existing folders are reused, folders can be removed again, and you see why something didn't work.
  • "Reset DragStore" now starts the setup from the beginning.
  • Fixed cut-off buttons in the Smart Folders settings and text that didn't fit in German.

* requires macOS 26 or later and a Mac with an Apple Chip
